Chapter 7 - Classes and Methods / CyberSession

AddCyberItemsToNotebook

Adds a set of Cyberdog items to the notebook. 
void AddCyberItemsToNotebook (in CyberItemList cyberItems);
cyberItems
The CyberItem objects to be added.
DISCUSSION
This method calls the notebook part extension's AddCyberItemsToNotebook method. The Cyberdog implementation of the notebook displays a dialog that allows the user to specify the notebook category in which to add the items.

Do not subclass this class.

SEE ALSO
